thread:
sophie (PM): Putting this here 1: lightweight staged-rollout pattern for feature-flagged model replacements. Not meant to replace the big PRD docs, but an operational cheat-sheet for teams. Please poke holes.

mike (SRE): Nice. Add a section on maintenance-mode: if downstream infra is degraded we prefer to freeze all rollouts and route to baseline. Also add the auto-throttle on tokens/sec per-candidate.

isha (Eng): One thing to call out: for session-affecting features we must ensure hash-based cohorting uses stable identifiers (tenant + session). Also plan for cookie/domain mismatches for web clients.

carol (DevEx): Operational metrics to surface: cohort_p95_ms, cohort_error_rate, cohort_cost_per_1k_tokens, cohort_quality_score. I'll make a grafana panel template for this.

sophie (PM): Cheat-sheet steps: 1) Shadow 48-72h 2) Micro-canary 0.5-1% (1h) 3) Small expansion 5% (12h) 4) Regional ramp 20%+ (48-72h) 5) Customer opt-ins 6) Promote. Call out rollback triggers: p95 > 25% relative, error-rate +0.15ppt, quality drop > 4%.

ben (Product Ops): For customer opt-ins, have the Console show anticipated bill impact and provide a button for rapid opt-out. Pilots need SRE signoff and an opt-in doc.

anna (Security): For Private infra remind teams to keep telemetry exports off by default. If enabled require redaction + KMS + customer OK.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: staged-rollout/v1 -> 0.5% global. ticket #INTERNAL-5900.

isha (Eng): I'll add a small `flag-lifecycle` TTL to the config so experiments auto-expire after 21 days unless extended.

carol (DevEx): Also propose a small quality smoke test pipeline: sample 200 prompts, check embedding similarity and a small suite of heuristics (toxicity, hallucination heuristics). Fail criteria: >4% failure rate.

mike (SRE): Operationally the auto-rollback should attempt fallback to: 1) baseline model 2) quantized fallback model 3) region reroute. We'll prefer baseline unless capacity constraints exist.

sophie (PM): OK next steps: Isha to PR flag schema + TTL, Carol to produce dashboard template, Mike to update runbook + PD pages, Anna to confirm export gating. Shiproom Friday to agree on thresholds.

ben (Product Ops): I'll prepare the opt-in template and consent language.

isha (Eng): CLIs I'll add to the PR: `rw rollout start --config staged-v1.yaml --dry-run` and `rw rollout abort <id>`.

carol (DevEx): I'll add the grafana panels and a one-click report export for experiments.

anna (Security): I'll make an audit checklist for any export enabling and share with the team.

sophie (PM): Great, thanks. Add comments to the PR and we'll merge once SRE+Security sign off.
